name: mobile-ios
description: Build native iOS apps (Swift/UIKit/SwiftUI): lifecycle, navigation, storage, App Store constraints. Use for iOS projects. Detect xcodebuild first.

name: mobile-android
description: Build native Android apps (Kotlin/Jetpack): lifecycle, coroutines, navigation, storage. Use for Android projects. Detect gradle first.

name: mobile-react-native
description: Build cross-platform apps with React Native/Expo: components, navigation, native modules, performance. Use for RN projects.

name: mobile-flutter
description: Build cross-platform apps with Flutter/Dart: widgets, state management, navigation, platform channels. Use for Flutter projects. Detect flutter first.

name: mobile-swiftui
description: Build SwiftUI interfaces: declarative views, @State/@Observable, navigation, performance. Use for SwiftUI code.
checklist: Expensive work off the view body
pitfalls: Heavy computation in the view body
State duplicated across sources of truth

name: mobile-jetpack-compose
description: Build Android UI with Jetpack Compose: composables, state hoisting, recomposition, performance. Use for Compose code.
pitfalls: Reading mutable state in the wrong scope

name: mobile-kmp
description: Share code across platforms with Kotlin Multiplatform: expect/actual, shared modules, platform APIs. Use for KMP projects.
checklist: Shared logic isolated from platform UI
pitfalls: Leaking platform types into shared code

name: mobile-expo
description: Build and ship React Native apps with Expo: EAS build/update, config plugins, OTA updates. Use for Expo projects.
checklist: Managed vs bare workflow chosen deliberately
pitfalls: Expecting native module freedom in managed workflow
Shipping breaking native changes as OTA

name: mobile-maui
description: Build cross-platform apps with .NET MAUI: XAML, MVVM, platform handlers. Use for MAUI projects. Detect dotnet first.

name: mobile-app-release
description: Prepare and ship mobile releases: signing, store metadata, versioning, review guidelines, staged rollout. Use when publishing to App Store/Play.
checklist: Store guidelines and privacy labels met
pitfalls: No staged rollout (bad build to everyone)

name: desktop-electron
description: Build cross-platform desktop apps with Electron: main/renderer, IPC, security (contextIsolation), packaging. Use for Electron projects.
checklist: IPC validated; no arbitrary main access
pitfalls: Exposing Node to untrusted renderer content (RCE)
Loading remote content with full privileges

name: desktop-tauri
description: Build lightweight desktop apps with Tauri (Rust + web frontend): commands, permissions, bundling. Use for Tauri projects. Detect tauri/cargo first.
pitfalls: Trusting frontend-supplied paths in Rust commands

name: desktop-qt
description: Build native desktop apps with Qt (C++/QML) or PySide/PyQt: widgets, signals/slots, event loop. Use for Qt projects.
checklist: Long work off the GUI thread

name: desktop-wpf
description: Build Windows desktop apps with WPF/WinUI (C#/XAML): MVVM, data binding, commands. Use for WPF/WinUI projects.

name: desktop-gtk
description: Build Linux desktop apps with GTK (C/Rust/Python/Vala): widgets, GObject, main loop. Use for GTK projects.
pitfalls: Threading GTK from the wrong thread

name: desktop-flutter
description: Build desktop apps with Flutter for Windows/macOS/Linux: platform channels, window management. Use for Flutter desktop targets.
pitfalls: Shipping a phone UI on desktop

name: desktop-javafx
description: Build cross-platform desktop apps with JavaFX (Java/Kotlin): FXML, scene graph, properties. Use for JavaFX projects.
checklist: Long work off the JavaFX Application Thread

name: cloud-aws
description: Build on AWS: EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, VPC, and the CLI. Use for AWS infrastructure/services. Detect the aws cli first.

name: cloud-azure
description: Build on Azure: VMs, Blob Storage, Functions, AKS, Entra ID, and the CLI. Use for Azure services. Detect the az cli first.

name: cloud-gcp
description: Build on Google Cloud: GCE, GCS, Cloud Functions/Run, GKE, IAM, and gcloud. Use for GCP services. Detect gcloud first.
checklist: IAM least privilege; service accounts scoped

name: cloud-cloudflare
description: Build on Cloudflare: Workers, Pages, R2, KV, D1, CDN/WAF. Use for Cloudflare edge projects. Detect wrangler first.
pitfalls: Assuming Node APIs in Workers runtime

name: cloud-serverless
description: Design serverless systems (Lambda/Functions/Workers): cold starts, statelessness, event-driven, limits. Use for FaaS architectures.
checklist: Cold start and timeout limits respected

name: cloud-cost-optimization
description: Reduce cloud spend: right-sizing, autoscaling, reserved/spot, storage tiers, waste detection. Use when cloud costs are high.

name: cloud-networking
description: Design cloud networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering, private endpoints, DNS. Use for cloud network architecture.
checklist: Private endpoints over public where possible

name: cloud-storage
description: Use cloud object/block/file storage well: classes, lifecycle, encryption, access control, durability. Use for storage design.
pitfalls: Wrong storage class for access pattern

name: cloud-managed-kubernetes
description: Operate managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE): node pools, autoscaling, IAM integration, upgrades. Use for managed k8s clusters.
pitfalls: Single node pool for all workloads

name: cloud-migration
description: Plan cloud migrations: assessment, 6 Rs, phased cutover, data migration, rollback. Use when moving workloads to/between clouds.
